summary: People living in each class of a categorical dataset, per org unit, as CSV

parameters.name: dataset_id
parameters.description: ID of the published categorical dataset (its template declares `classes`).

parameters.name: dataset_time
parameters.description: Time range of the class dataset to load, as [start, end] ISO-8601 date strings.

parameters.name: population_dataset_id
parameters.description: ID of the published population dataset, such as worldpop_population_global2_100m.

parameters.name: population_time
parameters.description: Time range covering exactly one population step, such as one year, as [start, end].

parameters.name: geometries
parameters.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection of organisation units. Each feature's `id` is kept as `feature_id`.
